process_input_messages: apply guardrails to OpenAI embeddings request input data containing strings or lists of strings
process_string_input: apply guardrails to a single string input for OpenAI embeddings requests
process_list_input: apply guardrails to a batch list of string inputs for OpenAI embeddings requests
process_output_response: skip guardrail processing on embeddings output responses since they contain vectors not text
create_openai_embeddings_handler: create an OpenAI embeddings guardrail handler that processes input text through custom guardrails
